# placed next to a redstone block: triggered, its tick runs and crafts nothing (1050)

B 4 -60 5 minecraft:crafter[crafting=false,orientation=up_south,triggered=true]
BE 0 -60 5 {Items:[],components:{},crafting_ticks_remaining:0,disabled_slots:[I;],id:"minecraft:crafter",triggered:1,x:0,y:-60,z:5}
